conditions.baseline: Same final Shipping binary with -LegacyPreviewCollision; existing scenery renderer in both variants.
workloads: Generated ten-floor interior: 225 rooms; no roads/context features.

interpretation: Resident bytes are working set; private committed bytes are a separate metric and must not be added.
Positive paired savings mean legacy minus optimized; each process phase is summarized by its median, then paired differences summarized across three repeats.
Short steady-state windows on one machine do not establish peaks, leaks or an app-wide average.
Timing uses monotonic intervals between diagnostic ticks, including settle/load hitches. Frame-capped sanity check, not an uncapped rendering throughput benchmark.
Empty baseline includes engine/driver caches; both absolute and baseline-adjusted differences are retained.

The floor-1-to-all-floors comparison is the within-process phase-median difference before and after revealing the remaining 203 rooms. It also includes rendering/caches/normal GC during the interval and does not isolate physical collision allocation bytes.
